about: The rulebook: the culture files and the role file of every seat. (The shared skills a seat is also given, listed in agents/shared/agent.yaml, are not part of it and are not capped.) A rule change replaces or merges with an old rule; the rulebook as a whole may not grow past max_lines. Raise max_lines only by a decision of the human, recorded in the Decisions log.
must_keep_about: Lines that carry a rule the crew's safety or honesty depends on. An edit to the rulebook may reword around them but may not lose them: scripts/clu rulebook fails if one is gone. To change one on purpose, change it here in the same commit, which makes the change visible in review.
